---
title: "Mundane atlas"
subtitle: "National charts in use, how firm their times are, and the events on record"
description: "World map of candidate national charts by confidence, with each country's candidates, event counts and a Vimshottari dasha timeline for every candidate that states a time."
---

Mundane astrology reads a country's events through a chart cast for its
founding. Practitioners disagree about which founding moment to use, and most
stated times are conventions (midnight, noon) rather than records of the day.
This atlas shows what the project has on file: every candidate chart with its
source and confidence, the events recorded for each country, and, where a
candidate states a time, the Vimshottari dasha periods that follow from it.

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** Countries are shaded by the firmest candidate chart on
file: darker means a time taken from a record of the day ("documented"),
lighter means a conventional or disputed time, and the plain surface means no
candidate yet. Click a country (or pick it from the list) to see its
candidates, their sources and its event counts. Choose a candidate with a
stated time to see its dasha timeline; a conventional time gives a
conventional dasha and is flagged as such. A country without any stated time
has no lagna and no dasha, and the study tests only sign-level features for
it until a sourced time exists. Colour by event count instead to see where the
event file is dense.
:::

```{ojs}
mundane = FileAttachment("../data/mundane_countries.json").json()
dasha = FileAttachment("../data/mundane_dasha.json").json()
world = d3.json(mundane.atlas_url)
land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries)
byAtlas = new Map(mundane.countries.filter((c) => c.atlas_id).map((c) => [c.atlas_id, c]))
byIso = new Map(mundane.countries.map((c) => [c.iso, c]))
CONF = ["none", "disputed", "conventional", "documented"]
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof colourBy = Inputs.radio(["Chart confidence", "Candidate charts", "Recorded events"], { label: "Colour by", value: "Chart confidence" })
```

```{ojs}
viewof country = {
  const options = [...mundane.countries].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return Inputs.select(new Map(options.map((c) => [`${c.name}${c.n_candidates ? ` (${c.n_candidates})` : ""}`, c.iso])), {
    label: "Country", value: "IN"
  });
}
```

:::

```{ojs}
fillFor = {
  const seq = palette.seq;
  if (colourBy === "Chart confidence") {
    const ramp = { none: palette.none, disputed: seq[3], conventional: seq[5], documented: seq[8] };
    return (c) => (c ? ramp[c.best_confidence] : palette.surface);
  }
  const value = colourBy === "Candidate charts"
    ? (c) => c.n_candidates
    : (c) => d3.sum(Object.values(c.events || {}));
  const max = d3.max(mundane.countries, value) || 1;
  const s = d3.scaleQuantize().domain([0, max]).range(seq.slice(2));
  return (c) => (!c ? palette.surface : value(c) ? s(value(c)) : palette.none);
}
mapChart = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1100));
  const h = Math.round(w * 0.5);
  const projection = d3.geoEqualEarth().fitSize([w, h], { type: "Sphere" });
  const path = d3.geoPath(projection);
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", [0, 0, w, h]).attr("width", w).attr("height", h)
    .attr("role", "img").attr("aria-label", `World map coloured by ${colourBy.toLowerCase()}`);
  svg.append("path").attr("d", path({ type: "Sphere" })).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", palette.axis);
  svg.append("g").selectAll("path").data(land.features).join("path")
    .attr("d", path)
    .attr("fill", (f) => fillFor(byAtlas.get(f.id)))
    .attr("stroke", palette.surface).attr("stroke-width", 0.6)
    .attr("cursor", (f) => (byAtlas.get(f.id) ? "pointer" : null))
    .on("click", (event, f) => {
      const c = byAtlas.get(f.id);
      if (!c) return;
      viewof country.value = c.iso;
      viewof country.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    })
    .append("title").text((f) => {
      const c = byAtlas.get(f.id);
      return c ? `${c.name}: ${c.n_candidates} candidate chart(s), best ${c.best_confidence}; ${d3.sum(Object.values(c.events))} events` : f.properties.name;
    });
  // Countries too small for the 1:110m outlines are drawn at their capitals.
  const small = mundane.countries.filter((c) => !c.atlas_id && c.lat != null);
  svg.append("g").selectAll("circle").data(small).join("circle")
    .attr("cx", (c) => projection([c.lon, c.lat])[0]).attr("cy", (c) => projection([c.lon, c.lat])[1])
    .attr("r", 4).attr("fill", (c) => fillFor(c)).attr("stroke", palette.ink2).attr("cursor", "pointer")
    .on("click", (event, c) => { viewof country.value = c.iso; viewof country.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })
    .append("title").text((c) => `${c.name} (capital)`);
  const sel = byIso.get(country);
  if (sel && sel.lat != null) {
    const [x, y] = projection([sel.lon, sel.lat]);
    svg.append("circle").attr("cx", x).attr("cy", y).attr("r", 6).attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", palette.ink).attr("stroke-width", 2);
  }
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-map">${svg.node()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
colourBy === "Chart confidence"
  ? swatchLegend([
      { color: palette.seq[8], label: "Documented time" }, { color: palette.seq[5], label: "Conventional time (midnight, noon, untimed)" },
      { color: palette.seq[3], label: "Disputed time" }, { color: palette.none, label: "No candidate chart yet" }
    ])
  : swatchLegend([{ color: palette.seq[2], label: "Fewer" }, { color: palette.seq[8], label: "More" }, { color: palette.none, label: "None" }])
```

## Country detail

```{ojs}
selected = byIso.get(country)
detail = {
  const c = selected;
  const ev = Object.entries(c.events || {}).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  return htl.html`<div class="af-drawer">
    <h3>${c.name} <small>(${c.iso})</small></h3>
    <p>Founding date on file: ${c.founding_date}; founding time ${c.time_known ? "sourced" : "not sourced"}.
      ${c.n_candidates} candidate chart(s), ${c.n_timed} with a stated time.
      ${d3.sum(ev, (d) => d[1])} recorded events${ev.length ? ": " + ev.map(([t, n]) => `${t} ${n}`).join(", ") : ""}.</p>
    ${c.candidates.length ? htl.html`<table class="table af-table"><thead><tr>
        <th>Event</th><th>Date</th><th>Time</th><th>Place</th><th>Confidence</th><th>Used by</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${c.candidates.map((k) => htl.html`<tr>
        <td>${k.event}</td><td>${k.date}</td><td>${k.time ? `${k.time} ${k.time_zone || ""}` : "none stated"}</td>
        <td>${k.place || ""}</td><td>${k.confidence}${k.conventional_time ? " (conventional time)" : ""}</td>
        <td>${(k.used_by || []).join("; ")}</td>
        <td>${k.source_url ? htl.html`<a href=${k.source_url}>${k.source_title || "link"}</a>` : ""}${k.source_checked ? "" : " (not yet checked)"}</td>
      </tr>`)}</tbody></table>` : htl.html`<p class="af-notice">No candidate chart on file yet. A sourced founding
        time can be proposed through the <a href="../contribute.html">contribution guide</a>.</p>`}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
eventsChart = {
  const ev = Object.entries(selected.events || {}).map(([type, n]) => ({ type, n }));
  if (!ev.length) return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-events"><p class="af-notice">No events on file for ${selected.name}.</p></div>`;
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-events">${Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 640), height: 40 + 30 * ev.length, marginLeft: 120, style: plotStyle,
    x: { label: "Recorded events", grid: true }, y: { label: null, domain: ev.sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n).map((d) => d.type) },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(ev, { x: "n", y: "type", fill: palette.series[0], rx: 4, title: (d) => `${d.type}: ${d.n}`, tip: true }),
      Plot.text(ev, { x: "n", y: "type", text: (d) => d.n, dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fill: palette.ink }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: palette.axis })
    ]
  })}</div>`;
}
```

## Dasha timeline

```{ojs}
timed = selected.candidates.filter((k) => k.has_dasha)
viewof candidate = timed.length
  ? Inputs.select(new Map(timed.map((k) => [`${k.event}, ${k.date} ${k.time}`, k.key])), { label: "Candidate chart" })
  : Inputs.select(["none"], { label: "Candidate chart", disabled: true })
```

```{ojs}
dashaView = {
  if (!timed.length) {
    return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-dasha"><p class="af-notice"><strong>No lagna, no dasha until a sourced
      time exists.</strong> ${selected.name} has no candidate chart with a stated time, so neither the ascendant nor the
      Moon's exact position at the founding moment is known.</p></div>`;
  }
  const chart = dasha.charts[candidate];
  const now = new Date();
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-dasha">
    ${chart.conventional_time ? htl.html`<p class="af-notice">This candidate's time is a convention, not a record of the
      day; the dasha below is equally conventional.</p>` : ""}
    ${dashaTimeline(chart, { palette, width: Math.min(width, 1100),
      from: new Date(Math.max(+new Date(chart.moment_utc), +now - 60 * 365.25 * 864e5)),
      to: new Date(Math.max(+now, +new Date(chart.moment_utc)) + 40 * 365.25 * 864e5) })}
    <p class="af-caption">Moon at ${chart.moon_longitude.toFixed(2)} deg sidereal at ${chart.moment_utc} (UTC); ${dasha.system}.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

## Sign-level features

Without a founding time only sign-level features can be tested: a transiting
planet against the signs of the natal planets. The table counts the feature
rows the pipeline has computed so far, by event type and transiting planet.

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(mundane.sign_features, {
  header: { event_type: "Event type", transit_planet: "Transiting planet", rows: "Feature rows",
            conjunct: "Same sign", opposition: "Opposite sign", aspect: "Whole-sign aspect" }, rows: 12
})
```
